name: AdaptlyPost Public API
description: REST API for creating, scheduling, and managing social media posts across Facebook, Instagram, Threads, TikTok, X (Twitter), Bluesky, Mastodon, LinkedIn, Pinterest, YouTube, and Google Business Profile. Register webhooks to receive `post.published`, `post.partially_failed`, `post.failed`, `post.scheduled`, `account.unauthorized`, `image.completed` and `image.failed` events. Read post performance through the `/analytics/*` endpoints: views, likes, comments, shares, followers and engagement rate per workspace, per platform, per day and per post, with a comparison against the previous window of the same length. Connecting an account imports its posts from the last 180 days, and analytics are kept from then on for as long as the account stays connected, so any date range in that history can be queried. A post keeps refreshing for 180 days after it is published and then holds its last captured numbers. Refreshes run on a schedule; `POST /analytics/sync` asks for one now. Webhook deliveries are signed: the `x-adaptly-signature` header contains `sha256=HMAC_SHA256(secret, "{x-adaptly-timestamp}.{rawBody}")`. Every response carries the RFC 9331 rate-limit fields so a client can pace itself instead of discovering the limit through a 429: `RateLimit-Policy`, `RateLimit-Limit`, `RateLimit-Remaining` and `RateLimit-Reset`, the seconds until the window rolls over. A 429 adds `Retry-After` with the same number of seconds. Limits are counted per API key.
